# SKU Category Templates

Defines the spec schema captured per `sku_master.category`. Source of truth for what fields a SKU form shows.

## ACC — Accessory (General)

```json
{
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "brand",
      "type": "text",
      "label": "Brand"
    },
    {
      "name": "item_name",
      "type": "text",
      "label": "Item Name",
      "required": true
    },
    {
      "name": "description",
      "type": "textarea",
      "label": "Description"
    }
  ],
  "variant_fields": [
    "brand",
    "item_name"
  ]
}
```
